arguments.command:
run_sql "
INSERT INTO hub_daily (iata, day, n_dep, avg_dep_delay, n_metar)
SELECT
    hub.iata,
    d.day,
    COALESCE(dep.n_dep, 0)                       AS n_dep,
    ROUND(dep.avg_dep_delay, 2)                  AS avg_dep_delay,
    COALESCE(m.n_metar, 0)                       AS n_metar
FROM (
    SELECT iata FROM aviation.airports
    WHERE iata IN ('ATL','ORD','DFW','DEN','LAX')
) AS hub
JOIN (
    SELECT toStartOfDay(toDateTime('2026-06-01 00:00:00')) + number AS day
    FROM numbers(30)
) AS d ON 1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT f.Origin AS iata, f.FlightDate AS day,
           count() AS n_dep,
           avg(DepDelayMinutes) AS avg_dep_delay
    FROM aviation.flights f
    WHERE f.Origin IN ('ATL','ORD','DFW','DEN','LAX')
    GROUP BY iata, day
) AS dep ON dep.iata = hub.iata AND dep.day = d.day
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT a.iata AS iata, startOfDay(m.valid_utc) AS day, count() AS n_metar
    FROM aviation.metar m
    JOIN aviation.airports a ON a.icao = m.station
    WHERE a.iata IN ('ATL','ORD','DFW','DEN','LAX')
    GROUP BY iata, day
) AS m ON m.iata = hub.iata AND m.day = d.day
"
